templates.name: Sample card
templates.purpose: A plain square card with one photo, a headline and the address. It exists to exercise the template contract, not to post.

fields.name: headline
fields.description: A few words across the top, such as Just Listed.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The property's street address.

templates.name: Just Listed
templates.purpose: A new listing for the feed or stories: full photo, price, address and facts, with the agent and brokerage along the bottom.

fields.name: headline
fields.description: The words in the top corner.

fields.name: price
fields.description: The list price, such as $1,185,000.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The street address, such as 512 Pine Avenue.

fields.name: city_line
fields.description: City, state and ZIP, such as Boulder, CO 80302.

fields.name: beds
fields.description: Bedrooms, as a number.

fields.name: baths
fields.description: Bathrooms, as a number such as 2.5.

fields.name: sqft
fields.description: Finished square feet, with a comma, such as 2,640. Use the square footage disclosure's number.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.description: The agent's name as it should appear.

fields.name: agent_phone
fields.description: The agent's phone number.

fields.name: brokerage
fields.description: The brokerage firm's name. Colorado requires it on every ad.

fields.name: brand_color
fields.description: The agent's main brand colour as a hex code, such as #1f3d2b. Empty keeps Corso's navy.

fields.name: accent_color
fields.description: A second brand colour for the thin accent lines, as a hex code. Empty keeps gold.
